hero.title_sub: Break through time - Find heritage gold
hero.desc: An edutainment brand about Vietnamese heritage, creating history exploration experiences through archaeological models combined with Augmented Reality (AR) technology. 14 dynasties of Vietnam are vividly recreated, turning history into an inspiring journey of discovery.
about.label: About Us
about.title: A JOURNEY TO AWAKEN HERITAGE
about.story_p1: Every artifact buried deep beneath the earth carries traces of a bygone era, preserving the wisdom, courage, and aspirations of our ancestors who shaped the country we know today. Yet over time, these stories have faded behind museum glass or within pages filled with countless dates and events.
about.story_p2: It's not that Vietnamese history lacks fascinating stories — it's that we haven't had enough opportunities to truly get close, touch, and experience the values still hidden within our heritage. From this reality, Khai An Su Viet began with a simple question: "What's inside?"
about.story_p3: From an archaeological model, an artifact gradually emerges. From that artifact, the story of a dynasty awakens, opening a genuine encounter with history through hands-on discovery.
about.story_quote: "When heritage is explored with curiosity and pride, history is no longer yesterday's lesson — it becomes a living part of today's generation's journey of growth."
about.meaning_khai: Khai (Open): To uncover the layers of time. It is the moment when each simulated layer of earth is gently removed, allowing the artifact and its story to gradually appear.
about.meaning_an: An (Seal): The mark left by our ancestors across generations. Every artifact, symbol, or historical trace carries within it a part of the memory of our culture, character, and national aspirations.
about.meaning_suviet: Su Viet (Vietnamese History): The thousand-year flow that has shaped Vietnam's identity. It is a journey of many dynasties, many people, and many values that continue to live on today.
about.meaning_quote: "Khai An Su Viet is not just a journey to find an artifact — it is a journey to open a seal and understand more about where we belong."
about.mission_p1: Khai An Su Viet carries the mission of innovating how history and heritage are communicated, creating a creative edutainment ecosystem with Vietnamese identity.
about.mission_p2: We aspire to nurture awareness of our roots, develop national cultural strength, and spread Vietnamese values sustainably in the new era.
about.mission_quote: "Creating a creative edutainment ecosystem rich in Vietnamese identity."
about.vision_p1: Khai An Su Viet aims to become the pioneering brand in history edutainment in Vietnam, creating a creative heritage experience ecosystem for the younger generation.
about.vision_p2: We aspire to be the bridge that brings Vietnamese history into modern life, while spreading Vietnamese cultural identity and values to the region and the world.
about.vision_quote: "Spreading Vietnamese cultural identity and values to the region and the world."
about.values_intro: Every product, every experience is built on unwavering core values:
about.value_authentic_desc: Content built from legitimate academic sources, conveying history truthfully.
about.value_creative_desc: Combining heritage with modern experiences, turning history into engaging entertainment.
about.value_responsibility_desc: Eco-friendly products, safe and non-toxic materials.
about.value_connection_desc: Bridging generations, connecting youth with heritage and family cultural values.
about.value_inspiration_desc: Igniting love for history, nurturing national pride in the younger generation.

collection.title: VIETNAMESE HISTORICAL MARKS
collection.scan: Tap your phone on the artifact with an integrated NFC chip to unlock the digital artifact.
guide.title: AWAKENING ARTIFACTS
guide.step1_desc: Open your phone and ensure the NFC feature is enabled (for newer iPhones, NFC is always on automatically).
guide.step2_desc: Tap the back of your phone (usually near the camera) to the NFC tag included with the product. A notification will appear on the screen.
guide.step3_desc: Click the notification link, and the browser will take you to the website. The corresponding artifact will be automatically unlocked and saved to your digital Collection.
guide.step4_desc: Admire the hyper-realistic 3D model or choose AR View mode to bring the artifact into your real space. Tap the screen to read historical anecdotes.
guide.hero_desc: Discover historical roots through a unique AR virtual reality experience. Step by step, decode the mysteries of Vietnamese dynasties.
guide.card1_sub: Break the layer of time yourself
guide.card1_desc: Take the archaeological model block and included tools out of the box. Place the product on a table or mat for easy cleanup after the experience. Use a small hammer and tool to gently remove each layer of simulated plaster.
guide.card2_desc: When the artifact gradually appears, use a small brush to clean it gently. Then, tap your phone on the included NFC tag to open the AR experience.
guide.card3_desc: Each artifact is a puzzle piece of the past. Through AR, children will know which dynasty the artifact belongs to, what it was used for, and its significance in Vietnamese history. From a small item, a whole ancient story will gradually unfold.
guide.card4_desc: After completing the discovery journey, place the artifact in a display corner to save your own achievement. Each found artifact is not just a collectible, but a small milestone on the journey to discover Vietnamese history.
